workspaces.title: Introducing Shared Workspaces!
workspaces.subtitle: Manage finances together with family and friends

feature1.title: Shared Workspaces
feature1.description: Create dedicated spaces to track expenses with your household, partner, or roommates.

feature2.title: Invite Anyone
feature2.description: Send email invitations to family members. They'll get access as soon as they sign up.

feature3.title: Role-Based Permissions
feature3.description: Control who can manage members (Admin) or just view and add expenses (Member).

feature4.title: Easy Switching
feature4.description: Jump between your personal and shared workspaces with one click from the sidebar.

unified_transactions.title: Unified Transactions View!
unified_transactions.subtitle: See all your money flow in one place

feature1.title: All-in-One Timeline
feature1.description: Expenses and incomes now appear together, sorted by date, giving you a complete picture of your cash flow.

feature2.title: Income Visibility
feature2.description: Income entries are highlighted in green with a + sign, making them easy to spot at a glance.

feature3.title: Strict Budget Tracking
feature3.description: Track against your set budget regardless of extra income. Stay disciplined even when you earn more.

feature4.title: Filter by Type
feature4.description: New Income filter lets you view only your earnings. Filter by expenses, income, or see everything together.

feature1.title: Plan Ahead
feature1.description: Know you have a payment coming up? Add it now as a scheduled expense so you don't forget.

feature2.title: Auto Appear
feature2.description: Scheduled expenses automatically show up in the correct month when it arrives.

feature3.title: Mark as Paid
feature3.description: When you pay a scheduled expense, mark it as paid to include it in your budget totals.

category_groups.title: Categories Got an Upgrade!
category_groups.subtitle: Your categories are now organized into groups

feature1.title: Organized Groups
feature1.description: Categories are now nested under parent groups like Food & Dining, Transport, and Housing for a cleaner overview.

feature2.title: One-Click Migration
feature2.description: Your existing categories will be automatically matched to the right group. Just hit "Organize" on the Categories page.

feature3.title: Better Insights
feature3.description: See spending broken down by group and subcategory, making it easier to spot where your money goes.
